import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_24/training_0.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes from all sources
dfs = []

# Load each source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target ['condition', 'click'],
# we can simply concatenate (union) them vertically.
# In this case, there is only one source table, so this is straightforward.
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the target schema and types match exactly
target_df = target_df.astype({'condition': 'int64', 'click': 'int64'})

# Write the resulting dataframe to the target CSV file path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_24/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
